description: Update message flags and tags: read/unread, flagged/unflagged, junk/not-junk, and IMAP tag keywords (e.g. $label1). Accepts an array of IDs for batch operations. Use addTags/removeTags to change tags without touching the others; `tags` replaces the whole set.

addTags.description: Tag keys to add, keeping existing tags (see the tags list from email_stats / tb tags)

removeTags.description: Tag keys to remove, keeping the others

tags.description: Replace all tags with exactly these tag keys (use [] to clear). Cannot be combined with addTags/removeTags

name: email_mark
